# Immich Public Proxy + Cloudflare Tunnel

## Goal

Public share links at `https://i1-proxy.beijns.eu.org/share/...` via Cloudflare Tunnel → IPP → in-cluster Immich. Immich itself stays on Traefik at `i1.beijns.eu.org` (no lockdown in this change).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  visitor[Visitor] --> cfEdge[Cloudflare_edge]
  cfEdge --> cloudflared[cloudflared_pods]
  cloudflared --> ipp[IPP_Service_3000]
  ipp --> immich[immich-server_2283]
  you[You_Tailscale] --> traefik[Traefik_s145]
  traefik --> immich
```

## Chosen approach

- **Raw manifests** (Vaultwarden-style), not the upstream umbrella `app-template` Helm snippet (docs are pinned to Immich chart 0.9.0 / IPP 1.5.4; your Immich is already HelmRelease 0.13.1 / app v3.0.3).
- **New Flux app** at [`anywhere/k8s/immich-public-proxy/`](anywhere/k8s/immich-public-proxy/) in namespace **`immich`** so IPP can use `http://immich-server:2283`.
- **New Flux Kustomization** [`anywhere/clusters/s145/immich-public-proxy.yaml`](anywhere/clusters/s145/immich-public-proxy.yaml) with `dependsOn: [immich]`, SOPS decryption (same pattern as Immich/Garage).
- **cloudflared credentials-file + ConfigMap ingress** (GitOps routing in-repo). One-time tunnel create outside Git; runtime config lives in k8s.
- **No Traefik IngressRoute** for IPP — public path is the tunnel only.
- Pin IPP to `s145` (next to Immich). Run **2** cloudflared replicas with soft anti-affinity (not on `tiny` nodes).

## One-time Cloudflare bootstrap (manual, before/during apply)

1. In Zero Trust (or CLI): create tunnel named `i1-proxy` (or similar).
2. Save credentials JSON (`AccountTag`, `TunnelID`, `TunnelSecret`) — this becomes a SOPS Secret.
3. DNS: CNAME `i1-proxy.beijns.eu.org` → `<TUNNEL_ID>.cfargotunnel.com` (proxied).
4. Cloudflare Cache Rule: **Bypass** for `i1-proxy.beijns.eu.org/share/video/*` (IPP video playback requirement).

## Manifests to add

Under `anywhere/k8s/immich-public-proxy/`:

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `kustomization.yaml` | Wire resources + optional values CM |
| `deployment.yaml` | IPP `alangrainger/immich-public-proxy:v3.2.0`, port 3000, env `IMMICH_URL=http://immich-server:2283`, `PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://i1-proxy.beijns.eu.org`, healthcheck `/share/healthcheck`, nodeSelector `s145`, modest resources |
| `service.yaml` | ClusterIP `immich-public-proxy:3000` |
| `cloudflared-config.yaml` | ConfigMap: tunnel name, credentials path, metrics `:2000`, ingress hostname `i1-proxy.beijns.eu.org` → `http://immich-public-proxy:3000`, catch-all `http_status:404` |
| `cloudflared-deployment.yaml` | `cloudflare/cloudflared` pinned tag, `tunnel --config ... run`, ready probe `/ready:2000`, 2 replicas, mounts config + creds |
| `cloudflared-secret.yaml` | SOPS-encrypted `credentials.json` (Flux decrypt) |
| `security-headers.yaml` | Not required for tunnel path (TLS terminates at Cloudflare); skip unless you later add a Traefik route |

`IMMICH_URL` must stay the **in-cluster** service URL, never the public Immich hostname.

## Flux wiring

Add [`anywhere/clusters/s145/immich-public-proxy.yaml`](anywhere/clusters/s145/immich-public-proxy.yaml):

- `path: ./anywhere/k8s/immich-public-proxy`
- `dependsOn: [{ name: immich }]`
- `decryption.provider: sops` + `secretRef: sops-age`
- `prune: true`, `wait: true`

No change required to [`anywhere/k8s/immich/`](anywhere/k8s/immich/) IngressRoute for this feature.

## Post-deploy Immich setting (manual UI)

In Immich **Server Settings → External domain**, set:

`https://i1-proxy.beijns.eu.org`

Share links generated in Immich will then point at IPP.

## Validation

```bash
flux reconcile kustomization immich-public-proxy -n flux-system --with-source
kubectl -n immich rollout status deploy/immich-public-proxy
kubectl -n immich rollout status deploy/cloudflared
kubectl -n immich exec deploy/immich-public-proxy -- wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:3000/share/healthcheck
curl -fsS https://i1-proxy.beijns.eu.org/share/healthcheck
# then open a real Immich share URL and confirm gallery loads
```

## Explicitly out of scope

- Locking down `i1.beijns.eu.org` Immich to Tailscale-only / mTLS (can be a follow-up).
- Routing IPP through existing Traefik ACME IngressRoutes.
- Migrating other apps onto this tunnel.

content.text:
Root cause: Immich is getting overwhelmed by the gallery thumbnail stampede — not a bad `IMMICH_URL`.

**What happens**
1. Opening a share loads dozens of `/share/photo/.../thumbnail` requests at once.
2. IPP fans those out to Immich (`fetch` → `immich-server:2283`).
3. Under that burst, Node fails with `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` → logged as `TypeError: fetch failed` → IPP returns 404.

I reproduced it from the IPP pod: **60 parallel thumbnail fetches → 8 OK, 52 `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`**. Single requests and `/api/server/ping` work fine. Immich server has **no CPU/memory limits set** and sits on the HDD-backed library, so a sudden burst stalls accepts.

**Not the cause**
- Wrong Immich URL (FQDN resolves; ping works)
- Tunnel / Cloudflare path (errors are IPP→Immich in-cluster)

**What will help (GitOps / CF)**
1. **Cloudflare Cache Rule** for `i1-proxy.beijns.eu.org/share/photo/*/thumbnail*` (cache everything) — biggest win for public galleries.
2. Optionally give Immich server real CPU/memory requests/limits in `anywhere/k8s/immich/values.yaml` so bursts are less likely to stall.
3. Keep the existing video **Bypass** rule; don’t cache `/share/video/*`.

I won’t change Immich values unless you want that.
